text_block_list.text:
Having business with Jungle Pocket,
I visited her classroom and found――

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san!!
Please take me on as your underling!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear.
Shot down mercilessly again, huh~

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, about earlier?
No matter how you look at it, that's a definite no.
choice_data_list: If you say "again this time," does that mean you get asked to do this a lot?
When you say "again," does that mean you get asked to do this often?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Right~ It's like a whole package deal: they ask to be my underling, and I give them a flat-out refusal.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Most girls give up at that point, though—

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san!!
Please reconsider, just one more time!!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm being completely serious!!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times you turn me down, I'm not giving up!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew, huff...
Thanks for running alongside me, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san!!
Today's the day you make me your underling—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
......
Didn't I tell you I'm turning it down?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So you become my lackey, and then what?
What're you gonna do after that?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No ambition, no resolve.
I've got no use for anyone with eyes like that.

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...About that...
...............I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's not like I didn't have ambitions.
'To become the star of the race'... I was pretty serious about it.

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I tried, I was always just a side character.
People laughed at me, and it hurt so much. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text: “I thought if I became a delinquent, no one would laugh at me... and maybe something would change.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Idiot!
Looking cool on the outside means nothing if you're lame underneath.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, being the lead is great, ain't it?
Sorry for saying you didn't have ambition!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Plain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No. It's true that I lost my confidence
and almost lost my way, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You just can't bring yourself to give up, can you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then don't you dare throw it away, no matter what.
Keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The one left standing at the end is the one who never stopped.
If you don't stop until the very end, you're the star.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Charge right through and show 'em your grit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—I think I might understand how she feels a little.
Realizing you're just a side character, feeling down and rushed.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The girls in the spotlight are so dazzling... and so far away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dants.
What part of you is a background character, huh??

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You never give up, you're stubborn as hell,
and you're always snapping right at their heels, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Same goes for today's match race. It was crazy fun!
choice_data_list: (She stole their hearts in record time again...)
Yeah, I really learned a lot from that tenacious run.
Yeah, I really learned a lot from that tenacious run, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Same goes for today's match race. It was crazy fun!
choice_data_list: (She stole their hearts in record time again...)
Yeah, I really learned a lot from that tenacious run.
Yeah, I really learned a lot from that tenacious run, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!!
J-Geez! That's what I mean, Pokke-chan!
choice_data_list: Pocket sure is a charmer, huh.
Pocket really is a charmer, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exactly!
She just hits the nail on the head with deep, important things and inner doubts... It's totally not fair~

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A foul, you say?
I ran into 'em fair and square, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Radiant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san!!
Please take me on as your underling!!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Radiant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
――To get strong like you,
and become the star of the show!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh...............
Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah yeah. Next time I'll have a strategy ready and blow right past 'em!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Auugh...
Th-Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
Isn't this where you say, 'I'm not gonna lose, dammit!'?"

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Radiant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san!!
Please take me on as your underling!!

text_block_list.name: Somewhat Radiant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
――To get strong like you,
and become the star of the show!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh...............
Do whatever you want.
